Here is the transcription of the historical marriage register page visible in `image_4b120a.png`.

Please note that these entries are written in a mix of Latin and English, which was common in 19th-century Irish parish registers. Latinized names (like *Joannes* for John, *Maria* for Mary) and abbreviations (like *de* for "of", *Matrimonium inierunt coram* for "entered into marriage before") are used throughout the top sections before transitioning mostly to English near the bottom right.

---
